script_text: A seismic shift in your first house redefines your identity, Aries. Monday to Wednesday, your ruling planet Mars in your sixth house sextiles Saturn in your first, boosting career and money stability. Tuesday harsh as Mercury in your fifth squares Uranus in your third, disrupting love and work; Wednesday shines as Sun in fourth trines Neptune in first, calming home. Thursday’s turning point: Venus in your fifth opposes Pluto in your eleventh, exposing romantic power plays. Friday to Sunday, Jupiter in fifth amplifies passion, making Saturday ideal for dates or pitches; Sunday’s Moon in ninth squares Mars, caution travel. Wednesday is your power day because Sun trine Neptune aligns your fire element with intuition. Tuesday is your worst day because Mercury square Uranus fractures heart and hustle. Rewrite career goals under Saturn’s first-house grip before weekend. Follow for daily updates.
